resources.string: "Select interior cameras on the viewing page."
"These camera features may keep cameras active while the vehicle is off and use battery power. Consumption varies by vehicle and use; it is not necessarily the same as Sentry mode."
"SOC and 12V thresholds are shared by motion detection, tablet display, recording and remote viewing. At or below either threshold, these camera features pause without changing their switches."
"Camera features are paused because charge is at or below a configured threshold."
"Unable to verify charge: %1$s. Protection for these readings is unavailable. Continue camera use at your discretion."
"Start cameras when a viewer connects, only if they are not already active."
"A private viewing link and password; no separate phone VPN client."
"Private: only authorized devices in your Tailscale network. Restrict access to your devices and the viewer port; the phone needs Tailscale."
"Public: anyone can reach the URL. HTTPS encrypts traffic but does not authorize visitors. A viewer password is required for both the page and video; public access without a password is not allowed."
"Enable MagicDNS and HTTPS in the Tailscale account. Connect the phone or PC to the same Tailscale network."
"Enable MagicDNS and HTTPS in the Tailscale account and allow Funnel in its access policy. Device authorization alone does not enable Funnel."
"Get the account token at myzrok.io → zrok → Getting Started, step 2. It connects the vehicle, not viewers; never share it. Set a separate viewing password below."
"1–63 lowercase Latin letters, digits or hyphens; no hyphen at either end."
"Stream ID: 1–64 Latin letters, digits or underscores. Case-sensitive; no spaces or hyphens."
"VDO password: 1–49 Latin letters or digits, case-sensitive. No spaces or other symbols."
"Enable viewing and set a valid stream ID and password. The link appears after connecting to VDO.Ninja; no account authorization is needed."
"The viewing password must not exceed 1024 characters."
"The account token must not exceed 4096 characters."
"Enter the Zrok account token before authorizing the vehicle."
"Authorize this device with the service, then return to the application."
"Could not prepare the local viewing server. Turn viewing off and on to retry."
"The embedded tunnel runtime failed. Retry viewing; if it fails again, share the application’s diagnostic logs."
"Could not start private Tailscale HTTPS access. Check MagicDNS, HTTPS and network connectivity."
"Could not start Tailscale Funnel. Check the account’s Funnel permission, HTTPS and network connectivity."
"Could not register the vehicle with Zrok. Check the account token, account access and network connectivity."
"Could not create the Zrok viewing link. Check account access and the network; details are in diagnostic logs."
"Could not open the provider authorization page."
"The viewer link appears after authorization and connection."
"Could not create a QR code for this link."
"This vehicle’s Tailscale node has not received Funnel permission. Allow the funnel node attribute for its account or tag in the Tailscale policy, then retry."
"This provider has one authorized access. Revoke it to replace the account or access."
"Remote revocation is still pending. Retry it before authorizing again."

"Only one viewer can connect at a time. Viewing shares cameras that are already active. Otherwise, cameras start on demand and session-owned resources are released when viewing stops. An offline vehicle cannot receive a request."
"Set a viewing password before starting public access."
"The camera stream is unavailable. Check ADB and camera readiness."
"Could not establish the viewing connection. Check authorization and network access."
"The internal viewing or camera service is unavailable. This is not an account authorization error."
"Could not read or save encrypted access data. Details are in diagnostic logs."
"Operation depends on the available vehicle components. Required capabilities are checked at runtime; failures and their causes are logged."
"Show a warning when motion is detected"
"Vehicle off • wait 2.5 s • show for 10 s; repeated detection extends the display."
"PNG / JPEG / WebP, up to 32 MB. An app-owned copy is kept."
"Built-in Tesla images are visual references; add and edit your own captions."
"Security mode activated. Video recording and monitoring in progress."
"Delete this template? If active, the first base template will be selected."
"No saved templates yet. Edit a base template or upload your image."
"Tap empty space to deselect; with no selection, tap to add a field. Drag a field to move it; hold and drag either side edge to resize."
"Could not save the template. Your changes remain in the editor."
"Could not read the image. Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 32 MB."
"The whole image stays visible. Empty margins may remain; proportions are preserved."
"Fills the area by cropping the image edges. Proportions are preserved."
"Invalid connection name. Use 1–63 lowercase Latin letters, digits or hyphens; no hyphen at either end."
"The provider could not complete startup. Retry without revoking access; details are in diagnostic logs."
"Could not load the saved Zrok identity or open its listener. Details are in diagnostic logs."
"The Zrok environment no longer exists in the account. Revoke this saved access and authorize again."
"Zrok returned no usable HTTPS viewing address. Details are in diagnostic logs."
"The viewing listener stopped unexpectedly. Reconnect; details are in diagnostic logs."
"The provider did not finish connecting within the time limit. Retry or check the network."
